name: Chief Minister's Farmers Service Centre
description: Establishes Farmers Service Centres to provide essential inputs, expert guidance and services to farmers across Tamil Nadu.

name: Hill Farmers Development Scheme
description: Supports hill and upland farmers with focus on minor millets cultivation, hill vegetables and farm mechanisation.

name: Rural Backyard Poultry Development Scheme
description: Provides livelihood opportunities for rural women through backyard poultry farming with training and financial support.
benefit: Training and financial assistance for poultry

name: PM-KISAN
description: Provides income support of Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families.
benefit: Direct income support of Rs. 6000 per year

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards containing nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Provides timely credit to farmers for cultivation and other agricultural needs.
